plan.workload_scope: Short unforced 2D Navier-Stokes trajectories; 72 configurations per grid, 216 total, not 216 per grid. Related seeds across grids/viscosities are 36 families, not independent training examples. Streamed storage only.

scope_notes: Sampled aggregate RSS sums the current process and observed descendants; it is not PSS, and shared resident pages can be counted multiple times.
This is not a true peak: short-lived children, orphaned descendants, and between-sample peaks may be missed. RSS reads are sequential, not atomic.
The interval is a requested wait between samples; sampling and OS scheduling add latency. Initial and final samples are also taken.
Partial samples sum only readable processes; errors count failed operations, not unique processes. Entirely unavailable components remain null.
Parent and child peaks can occur at different times; their sum need not equal the sampled aggregate peak. Sampler and existing process memory is included.

measurement_scope.wall_time: run_sweep: worker startup, solve, streamed write, hash, publication
measurement_scope.throughput: Successful completed experiments/hour, not timestep or frame count
measurement_scope.attempts: Completed plus numerical-failed experiments/hour, reported separately
measurement_scope.memory: Sampled sum of trial parent and descendant RSS; shared pages can repeat
measurement_scope.memory_limit: Sampling misses between-sample peaks; not true peak or PSS
measurement_scope.reuse: Verified immediate warm-cache repeat including worker-pool startup
measurement_scope.stored_bytes: Logical lengths of all committed artifacts, not disk allocation
measurement_scope.order: All grid/worker/repeat cases shuffled together with a fixed seed
measurement_scope.cache: OS caches are not flushed; fresh interpreter and lake per trial
measurement_scope.failures: Numerical failures retained and verified; infrastructure faults abort
measurement_scope.limits: One local host and short trajectories; no cloud/distributed/long-time physics claim. Three repeats show ranges, not statistical significance. Background load and filesystem effects are not controlled.
